triggers.name: check_vehicle_reservation
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER check_vehicle_reservation BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF vehicle_id, starts_at, ends_at, state ON app.resource_reservations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app.assert_vehicle_reservable()

triggers.name: check_vehicle_downtime
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER check_vehicle_downtime BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF vehicle_id, starts_at, ends_at ON app.vehicle_unavailability FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app.assert_vehicle_downtime_available()

triggers.name: check_vehicle_status_change
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER check_vehicle_status_change BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON app.vehicles FOR EACH ROW WHEN (old.status = 'ACTIVE'::text AND new.status <> 'ACTIVE'::text) EXECUTE FUNCTION app.assert_vehicle_status_change()

triggers.name: drivers_identity_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER drivers_identity_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON app.drivers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app.guard_driver_identity()

triggers.name: vehicles_fixed_driver_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER vehicles_fixed_driver_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF assigned_driver_id ON app.vehicles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app.guard_fixed_driver_vehicle()

triggers.name: employee_driver_requires_vehicle
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER employee_driver_requires_vehicle AFTER INSERT ON app.drivers DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app.assert_employee_driver_has_vehicle()

functions.name: guard_driver_identity
guard_fixed_driver_vehicle
assert_employee_driver_has_vehicle
assert_vehicle_reservable
assert_vehicle_downtime_available
assert_vehicle_status_change

constraints.name: app_users_photo_path_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (photo_path IS NULL OR length(photo_path) >= 5 AND length(photo_path) <= 300)

constraints.name: distribution_centers_address_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM address)) >= 5 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM address)) <= 500)

constraints.name: distribution_centers_name_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (name IS NULL OR length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) >= 1 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) <= 120)

constraints.name: drivers_employee_code_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (employee_code IS NULL OR length(TRIM(BOTH FROM employee_code)) >= 1 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM employee_code)) <= 40)

constraints.name: drivers_login_email_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (login_email IS NULL OR login_email = lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM login_email)) AND length(login_email) >= 3 AND length(login_email) <= 254)

constraints.name: food_requests_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (safety_review = 'PENDING'::text AND safety_reviewed_at IS NULL AND safety_reviewed_by IS NULL OR safety_review <> 'PENDING'::text AND safety_reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND safety_reviewed_by IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: no_overlapping_person_reservation
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (person_id WITH =, during WITH &&) WHERE (state = 'ACTIVE'::text AND person_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: no_overlapping_vehicle_reservation
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (vehicle_id WITH =, during WITH &&) WHERE (state = 'ACTIVE'::text AND vehicle_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: resource_reservations_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (state = 'ACTIVE'::text AND released_at IS NULL OR state = 'RELEASED'::text AND released_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: resource_reservations_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((person_id IS NOT NULL) <> (vehicle_id IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: vehicle_locations_tracking_consent_id_pickup_id_reporter_u_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tracking_consent_id, pickup_id, reporter_user_id) REFERENCES app.vehicle_tracking_consents(id, pickup_id, app_user_id)

constraints.name: vehicle_maintenance_records_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (next_service_due_on IS NULL OR next_service_due_on >= serviced_on)

constraints.name: vehicle_tracking_consents_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (withdrawn_at IS NULL OR withdrawn_at >= granted_at)

constraints.name: vessel_issuances_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (returned_at IS NULL OR returned_at >= issued_at)

constraints.name: vessel_issuances_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'ACTIVE'::text AND returned_at IS NULL OR status = 'RETURNED'::text AND returned_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: volunteer_application_review_fields
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'PENDING'::text AND reviewed_at IS NULL AND reviewed_by IS NULL OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['APPROVED'::text, 'DENIED'::text])) AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_by IS NOT NULL)
